menu_items.name: Fresh Tandoori Roghni Naan
menu_items.description: Soft leavened bread brushed with clarified butter, toasted white sesame seeds and baked against clay tandoor walls.

menu_items.name: Roasted Garlic Butter Naan
menu_items.description: Fresh clay oven tandoori bread slathered in melted butter, roasted minced garlic, and chopped coriander leaves.

menu_items.name: Cheese Stuffed Tandoori Naan
menu_items.description: Crispy outside, molten inside! Stuffed with mozzarella & mild cheddar cheese, herbs and brushed with butter.

menu_items.name: Traditional Peshawari Qahwa with Cardamom
menu_items.description: Brewed green tea leaves infused with green cardamom pods, cinnamon bark, served with saffron candy crystals.

menu_items.name: Shahi Malai Kulfi on Stick
menu_items.description: Dense, creamy frozen dessert made from reduced whole milk, infused with roasted pistachios, almonds, and rose essence.

menu_items.name: Artisanal Fresh Mint Margarita
menu_items.description: Fresh mint leaves blended with fresh lime juice, black rock salt, and ice-cold soda. The ultimate refreshing palate cleanser.

menu_items.name: Special Karak Doodh Patti Chai
menu_items.description: Slow-simmered rich full-cream milk tea brewed with cardamom pods and premium CTC black tea leaves.

menu_items.name: Hot Gulab Jamun with Rabri (2 Pcs)
menu_items.description: Soft hot fried dumplings soaked in rose cardamom syrup, served on a chilled bed of thickened pistachio malai rabri.

menu_items.name: Royal Chicken Dum Biryani
menu_items.description: Fragrant long-grain basmati cooked with saffron, marinated chicken, caramelised onions & secret house spices in a sealed copper handi.

menu_items.name: Mutton Special Dum Biryani
menu_items.description: Slow-cooked succulent baby mutton pieces layered with aged basmati rice, whole cardamoms, fried onions and saffron steam.

menu_items.name: Matka Dum Biryani with Chicken
menu_items.description: Traditional earthen clay pot chicken biryani sealed with dough, delivering intense smoky aroma, spiced potatoes and tender chicken.

menu_items.name: Desi Ghee Shinwari Chicken Karahi
menu_items.description: Fresh country chicken wok-tossed in pure organic desi ghee, ripe tomatoes, coarse crushed black pepper and ginger juliennes.

menu_items.name: Boneless Chicken Makhni Handi
menu_items.description: Velvety smooth tomato cream gravy with tender boneless chicken breast cubes, topped with fresh dairy butter and kasuri methi.

menu_items.name: Peshawari Mutton Shinwari Karahi
menu_items.description: Prime mutton cuts simmered in pure animal fat and butter with salt, green chilies and fresh tomatoes in a traditional charcoal wok.

menu_items.name: Smoky Beef Seekh Kebabs (4 Pcs)
menu_items.description: Melt-in-mouth prime beef mince seasoned with roasted cumin, brown onion paste, coriander seeds and charcoal grilled over hot embers.

menu_items.name: Charcoal Grilled Chicken Malai Boti
menu_items.description: Creamy boneless chicken thigh cubes marinated in heavy malai, crushed green chilies, white pepper, and seared over charcoal.

menu_items.name: Mutton Balochi Chops (3 Pcs)
menu_items.description: Tender mutton chops marinated in Balochi dried spices, ginger garlic paste and slow grilled till charred and crispy outside.

menu_items.name: The Foodies Crunch Burger
menu_items.description: Crispy fried buttermilk chicken fillet tossed in spicy glaze, topped with cheddar cheese, tangy coleslaw, garlic aioli on a toasted brioche.

menu_items.name: Double Beef Smashed Cheeseburger
menu_items.description: Two seared prime beef patties, double melted cheddar, caramelized onions, crisp iceberg lettuce and house secret sauce on potato bun.

menu_items.name: Peri Peri Loaded Crispy Fries
menu_items.description: Skin-on golden fries smothered with spicy crispy chicken chunks, warm cheddar cheese sauce, garlic ranch and pickled jalapeños.
